verdict.rationale: Sketch's own docs say developers can be invited to inspect designs for free in a web browser, with no Mac app needed, and can grab information for any part of a design. That covers the no-editor-seat inspection core. The evidence never specifies what Inspect actually exposes. Missing for 10: documented measurements/spacing, style values, asset export/download, code snippets for CSS/iOS/Android, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat

citations.quote: You can invite developers to inspect designs in your Workspace for free — they won't even need the Mac app (or a Mac) as it all happens in a web browser.
any developer can grab the information they need for any part of a design, at any time
Developers, managers, and stakeholders can view, inspect, and comment on your work
